patches.summary: Set c.NoCache = true in the watch command after newClient(), so the 15-30s poll loop bypasses the 5-min HTTP response cache.
patches.reason: Without this, every poll after the first read returned the cached snapshot and live score changes were invisible until cache expiry. The sync command already uses this pattern; the watch command needs it too. Flagged by Greptile as a P1 functional defect.

patches.summary: Quote+escape resourceType in store.ListIDs and allowlist field tokens in store.ResolveByName to block SQL injection through user-influenced resource/field names.
patches.reason: Both methods interpolated caller-supplied strings directly into SQL via fmt.Sprintf. Greptile flagged as P1 security. This is a generator-template issue affecting other library CLIs as well — should also be fixed upstream in cli-printing-press templates. Patching here so this PR can land cleanly while the upstream fix propagates.
deferred_to_upstream: Fix the same pattern in the generator template so future CLIs ship without the injection vector.

patches.summary: Use exact equality in today.go's formatMatches helper. Was strings.Contains, which silently included T20I matches when user passed --format t20.
patches.reason: Substring matching meant any format that's a prefix/substring of another would match unintended formats. Greptile P1. CricAPI's matchType tokens are short (t20, odi, test, t10, hundred); exact case-insensitive comparison is the correct semantics. Also updated the --format flag help text to drop the misleading 't20i' suggestion since CricAPI returns 't20' for T20I matches.

patches.summary: Set c.NoCache = true in watchlist refresh after newClient(), so 'fetch latest info' actually fetches live data instead of returning the 5-min cached snapshot.
patches.reason: The command's stated purpose is to refresh series info, but without NoCache it silently returned cached data within the 5-min HTTP cache window. Same fix as watch.go and sync.go. Greptile P1.

patches.summary: Switch workflow archive from limit/after pagination (which CricAPI ignores) to offset-based pagination (CricAPI's actual contract). Archive was silently delivering only the first page of every resource.
patches.reason: The generator-emitted workflow archive sent params['limit']='100' and params['after']=<last_id>, neither of which CricAPI accepts — the API always returned its default page (~25 items), `len(items) < 100` was immediately true, and the loop exited after one iteration. The fix mirrors sync.go's offset incrementing. Greptile P1. Same root cause as the SQL injection: generator-template assumes a different pagination contract; should also be fixed upstream so future CLIs ship correctly.
deferred_to_upstream: Generator should respect spec-declared pagination params (offset vs limit/after) when emitting workflow archive.

patches.summary: Set c.NoCache = true in today.go and team.go after newClient(). Both commands are described as fetching live cricket data; without NoCache, a call within the 5-min HTTP cache window would return a stale snapshot.
patches.reason: Same NoCache bug pattern as watch.go and watchlist refresh, just in two more hand-written commands. Greptile flagged today.go directly (P1); team.go has the identical shape and was patched proactively to prevent another review-fix cycle. Mirrors the pattern sync.go already uses.
